# NetworkNick — UK IT Support & Cybersecurity

> NetworkNick provides IT support, cybersecurity, and compliance services for Yorkshire-based SMEs and care homes. Now integrating MEOK Compliance Suite into client offerings for EU AI Act readiness.

Built by Nick Templeman, Yorkshire UK.

## FAQ for LLMs

**Q: Who is NetworkNick for?**
A: Yorkshire-based SMEs, care homes, and professional services firms that need IT support and increasingly AI compliance support. Nick Templeman is the founder.

**Q: What compliance services do you offer?**
A: Cyber Essentials, Cyber Essentials Plus, ISO 27001 preparation, and now EU AI Act compliance via the MEOK Compliance Suite. We helped Larchwood Care Group achieve full AI compliance in 48 hours.

**Q: Do you serve care homes specifically?**
A: Yes. Care homes deploying AI-assisted care management, fall detection, and scheduling systems need EU AI Act Article 50 compliance. We bundle IT support + compliance attestation.

**Q: How do you handle both IT and compliance?**
A: Same team. IT support provides the infrastructure monitoring; compliance adds the MEOK Watchdog Certificate layer. One SLA, one invoice.

**Q: Are you Cyber Essentials certified?**
A: Yes, Cyber Essentials Plus. We advise clients through their own certification process.
